name: novelist
description: Manage story assets, apply genre-aware writing strategies, review outlines and manuscripts, maintain continuity, and publish validated EPUBs.

interface.longDescription: Initialize a Markdown novel workspace, develop settings, characters, materials, plots, and outlines, apply genre-aware storytelling strategies, review outlines and manuscripts analytically, control continuity and reader understanding, create visual assets, and finish with a validated EPUB.
defaultPrompt: Create a new novel workspace and help me define its premise.
Plan or revise the next chapter with continuity and reader understanding in mind.
Review the current outline or manuscript analytically, then publish it as a validated EPUB.
